data.name: The Tower of Endless Night: Dawnless Crown
data.description: At the Tower's summit waits the Unbroken Thread's masterwork: the machine built to fuse two stolen bloodlines into one, still hungry, still unfinished. Five battles per floor. Take your accumulated winnings and leave early, or climb to the throne. Lose anywhere and you leave with nothing. Cast down The Endless Night for the climb's fortune.
data.successDescription: The Dawnless Crown is conquered and the throne is cast down.

objectives.description: Above the storm the Tower becomes what it always was: a machine. The eleventh floor is a surgery the size of a cathedral, iron needles racked in reverent rows, and the architecture itself is stitched, obsidian dark and storm violet sutured together seam by seam.
Floor 11: a Monk Ascendant bars the way.
objectives.drawDescription: The Tower accepts no draws, and it keeps everything you carried.
objectives.failDescription: The Tower claims the climb and every winning on your back. No one carries anything out of a loss.
objectives.fleeDescription: You flee the Tower empty-handed. Winnings only leave with a victor.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls and the Crown concedes a few more paces.

You take one floor of winnings out past the surgeon's table, wiped unsettlingly clean. This high, the machine no longer pretends the gold is anything but bait, and you no longer pretend you are not tempted by the next floor.

objectives.description: The Endless Night is cast down and the machine throne goes dark. It is over. The climb's whole fortune lies in the wreck of the Unbroken Thread's masterwork, and every coin of it is yours.
The Tower of Endless Night keeps everything. There is no reward for losing; you leave with nothing.
You walk out of the Tower with the black sun setting behind you, until tomorrow.
objectives.successDescription: The Dawnless Crown is conquered. What the Thread began, a climber ended, for today.

data.name: The Tower of Endless Night: The Marrow Vaults
data.description: The Tower is entered from below, through the vaults where the Unbroken Thread kept the elder sister and her light-devouring blood. Five battles per vault. After each keeper falls, take your accumulated winnings and leave early, or climb higher for more. Lose anywhere and you leave with nothing: there is no reward for losing. Conquer the fifth vault to claim the Eclipse Keystone and unseal the Stormcourt.
data.successDescription: The Marrow Vaults are conquered and the Eclipse Keystone is claimed.

objectives.description: The Tower of Endless Night is entered from below, through the vaults where the Unbroken Thread kept its miracles. Tally-marks scar the entry hall in a neat administrative hand: feedings, measurements, years. The Tower pays climbers in gold, and no one asks why a machine wants the strong to come inside.

objectives.description: The Warden of the Half Eclipse falls, and the Marrow Vaults lie conquered. You pry your true prize from the broken threshold itself, a sigil of marrow-black bone, and shoulder five vaults of winnings. Above you, the Stormcourt begins to thunder.
The Tower of Endless Night keeps everything. There is no reward for losing; you leave with nothing.
You step out of her prison with the night still standing behind you.
objectives.successDescription: The Marrow Vaults are conquered. Above the clouds, the Stormcourt is listening.

data.name: The Tower of Endless Night: The Stormcourt
data.description: Above the Marrow Vaults rages the Stormcourt, where the younger sister's god still screams in the thunder. Five battles per floor. After each keeper falls, take your accumulated winnings and leave early, or climb higher for more. Lose anywhere and you leave with nothing: there is no reward for losing. Conquer the tenth floor to claim the Aegis Keystone and unseal the Dawnless Crown.
data.successDescription: The Stormcourt is conquered and the Aegis Keystone is claimed.

You take your winnings, one floor of the court's winnings in hand, and shoulder through the pressure door into open air. The thunder does not follow you past the threshold. The Tower's wages climb with the storm, and it knows you know it.

You haul four floors of winnings out with the horn still ringing in the walls and the wind snapping at the last door. Above you, the eye of the storm waits, and it pays better than this.

objectives.description: The Sovereign Echo collapses into dead air and the Stormcourt is silenced. From the Echo's shattered chestplate you pull a conductor sigil of storm-violet, still humming with a god's grief, and take ten floors of winnings with it. Above, the Dawnless Crown turns in the starless dark.
The Tower of Endless Night keeps everything. There is no reward for losing; you leave with nothing.
You step out of the storm with the god's cry still ringing in your teeth.
